questions.question: Define the term 'circular flow of income'. (2 marks)
Explain why national income, national output and national expenditure are equal. (4 marks)
An economy has investment of $60bn, government expenditure of $90bn and exports of $50bn. Calculate total injections into the circular flow. (2 marks)

An economy has a marginal propensity to save of 0.15, a marginal propensity to tax of 0.25 and a marginal propensity to import of 0.10. Government expenditure rises by $80bn. Calculate the resulting change in real national income. (4 marks)
Draw an AD/AS diagram to show the effect on equilibrium real national output of a rise in government expenditure in an economy with spare productive capacity. (4 marks)
Analyse the effect of a rise in imports on a country's equilibrium real national output. (6 marks)
Examine the significance of the size of the multiplier for a government planning to raise its spending. (8 marks)
Discuss the factors that determine the equilibrium level of real national output in an open economy. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that increasing government expenditure is always an effective way to raise the level of economic activity. (20 marks)
